OmniControl Suite v8.12.5 - OptiRouter AI Restoration & Integration:
- Restored OptiRouter AI directly inside the 'Gaming & GPU' master hub under sub-category 1 (Gaming & GPU) and All Tools.
- Dedicated 'MANAGE APP ROUTING RULES' and 'AUTO-OPTIMIZE ALL INSTALLED APPS' buttons.
- Full support for adding custom .exe paths and assigning DirectX GPU preferences (dGPU vs iGPU).
- Zero layout overlap and persistent UXTU safeguards.
